latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of client-intake-bot-pro 1.0.0

- Launches an automated conversational system for qualifying and intake of freelance or consulting leads.
- Captures leads, asks dynamic questions, and scores prospects on criteria like budget, timeline, and fit.
- Sends personalized instant responses and routes hot leads for immediate follow-up; automatically nurtures or declines others.
- Offers flexible setup options for various services (e.g., web design, consulting) and supports branching qualification logic.
- Integrates with common CRMs, calendars, and email tools to streamline onboarding and lead management.
- Includes ready-to-use templates, notification rules, and multi-step nurture sequences for leads at all stages.
